headline: Extreme heat expires tonight — run zone 1, tip canes Monday.
weather_notes: Work only before 9 AM today — Extreme Heat Warning active through 9 PM MDT with 101°F highs and patchy smoke.
Run zone 1 beds today — 3 days without irrigation at 101°F exceeds the 1-day heat threshold.
Shade e1–e4 tomato beds through midday — 43-day transplants at 101°F are at sunscald risk.
Plan cane tipping and potato probe for Monday — 92°F is the best outdoor work window of the week with no rain through Tuesday.

surfaced_tasks.title: Tip new blackberry primocanes if 3–4 ft tall
surfaced_tasks.reason: 23 days overdue — Monday's 92°F drop is the first safe outdoor work window since the Extreme Heat Warning began.

suggested_tasks.title: Probe one potato bag for harvest readiness
suggested_tasks.description: Yukon Gold at 75 days is in the center of the 65–80 day harvest window — probe one bag Monday morning before heat-accelerated vine die-back closes the opportunity.

suggested_tasks.title: Check w4 onions for soft necks
suggested_tasks.description: Super Star onions at 99 days are entering their maturity window — feel for soft necks and falling tops before this week's sustained heat accelerates post-maturity softening.
